name: PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk
summary: Established in 1997 and headquartered in Jakarta Utara, Indonesia, PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk serves as a provider of surveying equipment across Indonesia. The company's diverse product portfolio features advanced total stations, RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) receivers, integrated Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) solutions, and precision theodolites.
